Bea (Docs): Quick thread: we need to finalize the changelog structure before tomorrow's cut. Product wants a tiny customer blurb, machine-readable migration notes, and localized short messages. Also need an automated sanity checklist for snippets.
Yusuf (Eng-ML): Agreed. Can we add a machine-readable 'migration.json' snippet so partners can parse endpoint changes? Helps integrators.
Bea (Docs): Good idea. Proposed schema (brief): {action: 'update_endpoint', from: '/v1/embeddings', to: '/api/embeddings', param_map: ['model->model_id']} — we'll include as a fenced JSON block in the changelog.
Clara (SDK): I like that. Make sure code snippets include both the new canonical example and a backward-compat shim comment. I'll prepare Python/Node examples.
Sam (QA): On snippets: can we add a lightweight CI job that runs sample inputs against staging and reports diff hashes? I've seen docs drift.
Bea (Docs): Yes — I'll add a checklist entry: snippet-tests pass + smoke-run hashes match expected. Where do we store the expected hashes?
Sam (QA): Store them in docs/.expected-snippets as a tiny YAML. CI job compares output. If mismatch, fail the PR.
Yusuf (Eng-ML): Also add a note about quantized-model regression: short history sessions sometimes show higher tail latency. We should include the known-issue with suggested mitigation (max_history_tokens).
Bea (Docs): Draft known-issue blurb: "Intermittent tail latency increase for long chat histories on quantized variants. Mitigation: set max_history_tokens=1024 or use the 'full-kv' variant." OK?
Yusuf (Eng-ML): LGTM. Add a link to internal eval dashboard: https://perf.redwood.internal/evals/kk-2026-embeds (internal only).
Clara (SDK): Snippet diffs I'll push: Node old fetch to /v1/embeddings -> new fetch to /api/embeddings with body key model_id. Also add streaming example change: generate_stream(..., enable_stream_fallback=true).
Bea (Docs): For localization: localize-bot, can you create keys for the small blurb and known-issue? We need EN/FR/DE/ES short versions.
localize-bot: Created keys: changelog.embed.announce, changelog.embed.known_issue. FR/DE/ES queued. Reminder: keep strings <120 chars.
Sam (QA): CI hooks: pls ensure linkcheck, snippet-tests, and expected-snippet-hash check run. If expected hash missing, warn not fail (for initial rollout) but require manual approval.
Bea (Docs): I'll add that behavior to the PR template: "docs-ci: missing expected-snippet-hash -> manual review required".
Clara (SDK): One more: Go examples use old import path "github.com/redwood/sdk"; will change to "github.com/redwood/inference-go/sdk" and update constructor WithAPIHost("api.redwood.ai").
Yusuf (Eng-ML): Add a short rollback line in the changelog: "If you observe >10% tail-latency regressions, switch routing policy to legacy-prefetch and contact support with traces." Keep it one sentence.
Bea (Docs): Done. Also adding an ops/runbook link: /ops/runbooks/changelog-rollback.
docs-ci: linkcheck started for branch release/changelog-machine-readable (checks: linkcheck, snippet-tests)
docs-ci: linkcheck: found one reference to /v1/embeddings in docs/legacy/old-snippets.md :warning:
Bea (Docs): I'll remove old-snippets.md references and add a redirect notice if needed.
Clara (SDK): I'll open PR 5012 with the snippet updates and the machine-readable JSON block.
docs-ci: snippet-tests queued. Will also run expected-snippet-hash comparison after PR lands.
docs-ci: build passed (linkcheck fixed, snippet-tests passed, expected-hash warnings: 0) :white_check_mark:
Bea (Docs): Final checklist before merge: 1) include machine-readable migration JSON block (Bea) 2) update snippets (Clara) 3) add expected-snippet-hash entries (Sam) 4) i18n keys queued (localize-bot) 5) PM sign-off (Yusuf) 6) docs-ci green.
Yusuf (Eng-ML): PM sign-off for copy and rollback wording.
Bea (Docs): Merging after CI green. I'll publish the changelog at 17:00 UTC and ping Marketing with the short blurb and the machine-readable migration note for partners. If anything pops, follow /ops/runbooks/changelog-rollback. :rocket:
